responsibility: Public declarations for RTL SSA resources, accesses, definitions, and lookup results. This header defines the resource_info abstraction for registers and memory, the access_kind and printing flags, the access_info class hierarchy for sets, phis, clobbers, and uses, and the def_mux/def_lookup interfaces used to query and print SSA definition state.
same_name_distinction: Declares the RTL SSA access/resource type system and query/printing interfaces that accesses.cc implements, including resource_info, access_info subclasses, def_node/def_mux/def_lookup, and printing flags; unlike accesses.cc, it is the interface and data-layout definition point rather than the algorithm body.
